timelineSteps.title: Candidacy received
timelineSteps.info: Threat: a stranger posts a candidacy to get a machine enrolled. Nothing is trusted until the admin approves it here.

timelineSteps.title: Details checked
timelineSteps.info: Threat: a lookalike machine. The name, hostname and address shown are informative, not proof: compare them with the machine you expect.

timelineSteps.title: Passphrase and signature
timelineSteps.info: Threat: a local process signing for you. The passphrase is typed in the approval dialog of this page (or in the terminal that runs `machine admin approve`), used for ONE signature made in the browser and never sent: the daemon and the module backend only receive what is already signed.

timelineSteps.title: Documents distributed
timelineSteps.info: Threat: peers keep an old view of the network. The signed documents are sent to the peers so that every machine trusts the new one. A machine that is offline gets them from the relay inbox when it is back.

timelineSteps.title: Security code compared
timelineSteps.info: Threat: the relay swaps a public key (candidate or admin). Compare the security code on the candidate machine, never the one displayed by the relay.
